tiers.text: Saying 'TDD' is not the same as doing it. When did a test first fail?
If tests and code arrived together and the first run was green, red never happened. A test that has never failed might not be able to fail. Also check where each expected number came from.

Honest answers: red was probably never seen (n), and the numbers probably came from the agent's head or from running the code (b or c). Hand calculation by a human is (a); an independent reference is (d). Remember: you did not ask the agent to wait for you.
